# DSH Session Search
English | 简体中文
Message-level search across every session in the DSH desktop app.
> Full-text search across all past sessions. Chinese single characters and keywords both work; resul
ts are compact conversation-turn rows with jump-and-highlight. Everything stays local in a SQLite in
dex — no network, no uploads.
## Features
- **Sidebar panel + header shortcut** — a magnifier entry in the sidebar, plus a compact "Search his

tory" button next to the session title.
- **Search every session** — message-level full-text search
across all workspaces. Chinese single characters, words, Markdown source and LaTeX formulas are all

searchable.
- **Compact turn rows** — one row per conversation turn, WeChat-style: title + turn numb
er + date, a single highlighted snippet, and an expand button for the remaining hits. The first scre

en returns 5 turns; "View all" extends it to 200 in place.
- **Relevance-first ranking** — BM25 rele
vance for user/assistant text, plus keyword position, source type and exponential recency. Switch be

tween *Relevance* and *Newest* at any time.
- **Jump and highlight** — clicking a result opens the s
ession, scrolls to the exact turn, expands collapsed tool calls or reasoning blocks when the hit liv

es inside them, and highlights the match in the chat.
- **Local-only index** — SQLite FTS5 (trigram)
built automatically on first use, kept up to date incrementally, and compacted automatically. Rough

ly 40 MB for 22k messages; the session logs themselves are never modified.
- **Robustness** — a corr
upted index is rebuilt automatically; one unreadable session never stops the build; missing host ser
vices only disable the panel, not the app.
## Requirements

- DSH desktop **0.2.1-rc.3** (tested).
- Host services `webServer`, `sessionPersistence` / `sessionQ

uery`, and Node's `node:sqlite`.
If any of them is missing, the plugin still loads and the panel exp
lains what is unavailable.
## Installation
Download the `.tgz` from the repository release, then either:
**Plugin manager**

1. Open DSH → **Plugins** → **Add** → **Local path**.
2. Select the `.tgz` (or an extracted director

y if your plugin manager only accepts folders).
3. Restart DSH, or wait for the hot reload.
**CLI**
[代码示例省略，未执行]
After activation, open **Session search** from the sidebar. The first open builds the index in the b
ackground and shows progress; already-indexed content is searchable meanwhile.
## Usage

- Type a keyword and press Enter. Single Chinese characters work too.
- **Source filters** — by defa
ult only *You* and *Assistant* are searched. Enable *Tools*, *Reasoning* or *System* when needed; th

e index already contains them, they are just filtered out by default.
- **Sort** — *Relevance* (defa

ult) or *Newest*.
- **View all** — the first screen shows 5 turns; the button at the bottom expands

the same result set to 200 turns without re-running the query.
- **Click a row** — opens the source
session at that turn and highlights the match. If the hit is inside a collapsed tool call or reasoni
ng block, the plugin expands it first. If the chat UI genuinely does not render the hit (injected sy

stem context, truncated tool cards), a toast tells you so instead of highlighting the wrong place.
-
**State is remembered** — query, filters, sort, expanded rows and scroll position survive jumping i
nto a conversation and coming back.
## How it works
[代码示例省略，未执行]
- The host half reads session events through `sessionPersistence` / `sessionQuery`, folds them into

searchable messages, and stores them in `~/.dsh/storages/session-search.sqlite`.
- The FTS index onl
y covers conversation text (user + assistant). Tool, reasoning and system text are searched with `LI

KE` when those sources are enabled, which keeps the index an order of magnitude smaller.
- The clien
t half is a normal Cordis client plugin: a `sidebar.panellist` entry, a `main` panel keyed by the sa
me id, and a `conversation.header.leading` shortcut. It talks to the host over the same-origin HTTP

routes above.
- The index is derived data: you can delete it at any time, or use **Rebuild index** i

.
- The index is derived data: you can delete it at any time, or use **Rebuild index** in the panel.
## Privacy

- Everything is local. The plugin does not send any message content anywhere.
- The index stores mes
sage text (that is what makes it searchable). Treat `~/.dsh/storages/session-search.sqlite` as sensi

tive; delete it if you want to remove the index.
- Session logs are opened read-only and are never m

lete it if you want to remove the index.
- Session logs are opened read-only and are never modified.
## Known limitations
- Very old session log formats may be refused by the host; the panel shows how many sessions were sk

ipped.
- Searching tools / reasoning / system is slower (roughly 60–80 ms) because it uses a substri

ng scan instead of the trigram index.
- Some hits cannot be highlighted because the chat surface doe
s not render them: injected system context, tool cards that only show a truncated summary, and reaso

ning hidden by the current display mode. The plugin locates the turn and explains instead.
- Jumping

to an old turn in a very large session can take a few seconds while the chat loads history.
- The j
ump/highlight integration relies on DSH chat DOM contracts; it is tested against 0.2.1-rc.3 and may
need updates for other versions.
